intent: Make irrigation and farmland identifiable around unchanged city sprites.

assets.prompt: Edit the supplied replacement irrigation sprite into a production-ready high-resolution terrain OVERLAY for a classic historical 2D isometric civilization strategy game. The supplied image is our own generated artwork, an edit target and painterly style reference; preserve its rich hand-painted botanical detail, warm natural light, earth colors and muted turquoise irrigation water. Replace its compact raised garden silhouette with a LOW, FLAT, WIDE agricultural terrain patch: a precise isometric diamond twice as wide as it is tall, horizontal long axis, filling almost the entire image width. Broad cultivated green crop rows and a few warm ochre harvested strips cover the diamond right out toward its left, right and bottom points. Several clear continuous narrow turquoise water ditches with dark earth banks cross between the fields and continue along the foreground edges. No raised stone garden borders, walls, waterwheel, towers, palms, fences, buildings, people, icons or text. This must read as irrigated land rather than a building. The central half of the terrain will often be hidden behind a city sprite, so make the outer left/right thirds and the lower foreground fringe clearly identifiable as watered cultivated fields in their own right. Low plant height only; no floating slab, no thick side faces, no cast shadow outside the diamond. Straight outer diamond edges, organic painterly texture inside; strong enough row and water contrast to be readable when reduced to a 64x32 pixel tile. Transparent background outside the diamond, true RGBA alpha, no checkerboard. Landscape canvas 1536x768 if possible, centered diamond with only a tiny transparent margin; retain fine native-resolution painted detail.

Create the FARMLAND counterpart to the supplied flat irrigation terrain overlay, using the first image as the exact composition and painterly-style reference, and the second image (our old farmland sprite) as the subject reference. These are our own generated assets. Produce one production-ready transparent RGBA terrain overlay for a historical 2D isometric strategy game, at high native resolution. A precise flat isometric diamond twice as wide as tall, horizontal long axis, nearly edge-to-edge on a landscape canvas. Keep the first image's flat terrain perspective and muted natural painterly palette. Farmland should be distinguishable from ordinary irrigation: predominantly dense GOLDEN wheat and pale harvested stubble in long parallel cultivated rows, with a few green crop strips and narrow subdued blue-green water ditches. Agricultural detail must extend into both outer wings and foreground fringe so it remains legible around a large city drawn over the center. No buildings, walls, fences, trees, people, text, waterwheels or standing structures; no raised slab or thick side faces. No decoration outside the diamond. Strong broad row patterns that still read at 64x32 native pixels; rich fine detail at high resolution. Keep the background genuinely transparent. Landscape 1536x768 if possible with only a tiny transparent margin.
